UNIT CORRECTED. Both p.1 and p.3 print 'up to 500 tonnes of salt slag per tonne of aluminium', which is impossible - it would mean 500 t of waste from 1 t of product. kg/t is the only physically sensible reading and is what is recorded; the value is exactly as printed. Salt can be recovered by separation and crystallisation and the aluminium oxide fraction sold to the mineral industry, so this is not all landfill.
